name: Los Andes CRM
summary: A multi-company CRM that centralizes calls, customers, financial activity, users, and operational records across several business areas.
functions: Registers calls and customer activity by company and sector, covering rentals, real estate, security cameras, products, finances, users, and permissions.
problem: Customer interactions and financial movements from different companies and business areas were difficult to separate, organize, and trace.
solution: I developed a role-based CRM that segments records by company and sector while centralizing calls, finances, system activity, users, and permissions.

demo.title: Private system
demo.description: Public access is unavailable because the platform belongs to the company and contains sensitive customer, financial, and operational data.
